content_zh: 北镇抚司，监狱。经过一夜的磨合，唐逸和萧棣已经哥俩好了。闲聊下来，唐逸总算知道这家伙贵为皇子，为何总是一身匪气了。他自幼是在武当长大的，小的时候就跟着师兄师姐走南闯北，行侠仗义，快意恩仇，随后又被扔去边军历练了几年，这要还有皇家贵气那才见鬼。他也是半月前才回到京都。回到京都的第一件事，就是拔刀砍了宁安侯世子，也就是宁川的弟弟，宁二。也就和萧棣相处一个晚上，唐逸才发现虽然自己拼命在唐敬的书房补充这个世界的知识了，但是，他对这个世界的了解还是太少了。譬如，武功。武功他也会，前世十几个敌人，也别想近他的身，甚至就连之前面对宁川身后的锦衣卫，他自认前世的自己也有一搏之力。可当昨晚见到萧棣一拳将地面砸出一条十几米的裂缝后，唐逸就特妈怀疑人生了。科学？我科学你大爷！科学家的祖宗来到这个世界也无法解释什么叫真气好吧！于是，原本还想在萧棣面前拿捏姿态的唐逸，当场就老实了，生怕萧棣一个不高兴，一拳将他砸成两截。两人聊了半宿，迷迷糊糊中才相拥睡了过去……以至于早上的时候，清醒过来的两人第一时间就是检查菊花！“草，喝酒就喝酒，你抱着我干嘛？”萧棣瞪着眼睛，一身鸡皮疙瘩都起来了。“你妹，你还好意思说？你那拳头比我脑袋还大，就架在我脑袋上，我敢动吗？”唐逸也很崩溃，主要是憋尿二兄弟一柱擎天，然后又从后面抱着萧棣……想到那画面，简直不忍直视啊！“那是你让我教你武功！”萧棣怒。“呵呵，你那是教吗？你那分明是想拿我当沙包。”“你欺负我妹。”“胡说，我那是救她。”“妈的，你昨晚说梦话了，好大，一个手掌抓不完……”“……”“薄唇好软，很舒服。”“……”唐逸盯着萧棣，一张脸黑如锅底。你大爷，你能有点脑子吗？就算老子说梦话，那……呸，老子从来不说梦话！“唐逸，你可以走了。”两人大眼瞪小眼，宁川的声音从外面传来。“开门，和这蠢货待在一起，影响智商。”唐逸转身就走，义正词严。溜了溜了，不溜要被打啊！“他凭什么能走？我凭什么不能出去？”萧棣咬牙切齿，宁川漠然看着他：“你砍了我弟弟，我现在没和你动手，很给你面子了，我今天心情很不好，你想练，我陪你。”“不用，不用，我就喜欢坐牢。”萧棣顿时满脸笑容，连连摇头。唐逸看了一眼宁川，心说这家伙肯定比萧棣还牛逼，不然，就萧棣那拼命三郎的尿性，能这么轻易就算了？“昨晚你指证的间谍，死了。”两人往监牢外走，宁川忽然说道。唐逸脚步微微一滞，道：“能说说？”宁川想了想，将事情原原本本给唐逸说了一遍，这是炎文帝的意思。唐逸听完后，站在北镇抚司的大门前，沉默了很长一段时间。“他，埋在哪里？”许久，唐逸开口问道。“北城外十里地最高的那座山上，那里看北境，能看得更远。”宁川抬头看向北方。“谢谢。”唐逸笑了笑，道：“走吧，去见萧叔和狄老将军。”……小半个时辰后。状元街外的酒楼中。唐逸推开门的时候，果然看到了萧策和狄苍已经在里面。两人见到他，目光那是一个炙热。刚刚经历萧棣的事，唐逸都看得有些发毛，身体后仰下意识咽了咽口水。“小子，你有退敌之策？”炎文帝直接开口问道。现在他没时间，直接开门见山。“有，时间上也来得及，足够了。”唐逸也没有废话，他是要走武路夺权的，谦虚个毛？他说道：“退敌之策就是：东抗东虞，北放北狄。”“简单来说，在东境立即封锁边境，断绝和东虞的所有来往，调集重兵在边境集结，做出要全力攻打东虞的样子。”“既然他们毁约，那就做出不死不休的态度出来。”“至于我大炎北境则可内紧外松，可以直接提前开放边境互市，甚至可以优惠一点，往年一只羊能换五十斤米，现在一只羊可以换六十斤米……”唐逸话没说完，炎文帝一巴掌拍在桌上，眼眸极亮：“妙，妙极了！”他已经明白了唐逸的意思。东抗东虞，北放北狄。说直白点，就是在东境制造紧张局势，在北境佯装放松对北狄的戒备等级。紧张局势让东虞以为大炎要攻打东虞，再让东虞知道大炎和北狄还互市，那东虞会怎么想？东虞肯定会觉得北狄和大炎已经勾结在一起，等着他们的军队过去送死呢！毕竟，这些年北狄几乎都是靠大炎养着的。如此一来，东虞只能将军队撤回去！而北狄呢？北狄向大炎开战的借口，就是过冬物资。行，你们不是要过冬物资吗？换给你们就是了！而且换物资的时候，可以适当放一些流言，告诉北狄人他们的可汗发动战争是想要拿他们的命，去换他的荣华富贵！他们有物资过冬了，没必要再拿命去给别人做嫁衣……这种事那群御史玩得贼溜，派个御史过去就可以了。到时候就算北狄可汗强行开战，军心不稳，他还能打？“哈哈……就算东虞不凑热闹，边境互市，就是制裁北狄王廷最好的计策！”炎文帝兴奋不已。唐逸点头，道：“此举不但能拉拢北狄边民，甚至北狄权贵们看到如此惠利互换，也必然坐不住，会参与进来……届时他们一旦习惯，北狄王庭想要再乱动，可就没现在容易了，那么……我们便将在后续博弈中占据主动！”“进可攻，退可守！”“好，好！”炎文帝激动站起身，呸，满朝文武皆是屠狗辈，还不如一个少年呢！他双手叉腰心情大好，冲着唐逸道：“小子，你这次立大功了，赏赐我们会报上去，包你满意。”“小子，真有你的，满朝文武都搞不定的事，你竟然三言两语就搞定了。”狄苍一巴掌拍在唐逸肩膀，也是相当满意！原以为这小子只是写诗厉害，没想到眼界也不错，问题也看得挺透彻。朝中文臣武将还在内斗的时候，他却连解决问题的策略都已经想到了，这一点真真难得可贵。“唐敬这老小子，非人哉！”老将军也是破口大骂，愤愤不平。多好的孩子啊！瞧瞧这智商，瞧瞧这勇气，再瞧瞧这气势，特妈的有哪一点比不上唐画那个兔崽子？唐敬那老小子，真真是瞎了眼了！

Beizhen Fusi, prison. After a night of running-in, Tang Yi and Xiao Di were already good friends. After chatting, Tang Yi finally understood why this guy always looked gangster despite being a prince. He grew up in Wudang. When he was young, he traveled around with his senior brothers and sisters, performing chivalrous acts and grudges. Later, he was thrown into the frontier army to train for several years. It would be damning if he still had royal nobility. He only returned to Kyoto half a month ago. The first thing he did when he returned to Kyoto was to draw his sword and kill Ning'an Hou Shizi, Ning Chuan's younger brother, Ning Er. After spending only one night with Xiao Di, Tang Yicai realized that although he worked hard to supplement the knowledge of the world in Tang Jing's study, he still knew too little about the world. For example, martial arts. He knew martial arts, and even the dozen or so enemies in his previous life could not get close to him. Even when he faced the Jin Yiwei behind Ning Chuan before, he believed that he was capable of fighting in his previous life. But when he saw Xiao Di punching a crack of more than ten meters on the ground last night, Tang Yi became extremely suspicious of life. science. I'm scientific about your uncle. Even if the ancestors of scientists came to this world, they couldn't explain what true energy is. Therefore, Tang Yi, who originally wanted to show off his attitude in front of Xiao Di, acted honestly on the spot, fearing that Xiao Di would be unhappy and punch him in two. The two chatted for half a night, and then fell asleep hugging each other in a daze...so that when they woke up in the morning, the first thing they did was check their anus. "Fuck, just drink, why are you holding me?
Xiao Di stared, with goosebumps all over his body. "Your sister, you still have the nerve to say that." Your fist is bigger than my head, and it is placed on my head. Do I dare to move? "Tang Yi also collapsed, mainly because the two brothers held back their urine and hugged Xiao Di from behind... Thinking of that scene, I couldn't bear to look at it. "That's because you asked me to teach you martial arts. Xiao Di was angry. "Haha, are you teaching?" You clearly want to use me as a punching bag. "You bullied my sister." "Nonsense, I was saving her." "Damn, you were talking in your sleep last night. It's so big that it can't be grasped with one palm..." "..." "The thin lips are so soft and comfortable." "..." Tang Yi stared at Xiao Di, his face as dark as the bottom of a pot. Your uncle, can you have some brains. Even if I talk in my sleep, then... Bah, I never talk in my sleep. "Tang Yi, you can go." "The two stared at each other, and Ning Chuan's voice came from outside. "Open the door and stay with this idiot, it will affect your IQ. "Tang Yi turned around and left, speaking sternly. If you slip away, you will be beaten if you don't slip away. "Why can he leave?" Why can't I go out? "Xiao Di gritted his teeth, and Ning Chuan looked at him indifferently: "You killed my brother, and I won't fight with you now. It's a shame for you. I'm in a bad mood today. If you want to practice, I'll accompany you. "No, no, I just like going to jail." "Xiao Di suddenly smiled and shook his head repeatedly. Tang Yi glanced at Ning Chuan and said in his heart that this guy must be more awesome than Xiao Di, otherwise, Xiao Di's desperate personality would be able to let it go so easily.
"The spy you testified against last night is dead." Ning Chuan suddenly said as they walked out of the prison. Tang Yi's steps stagnated slightly and said, "You can tell me." Ning Chuan thought for a while and told Tang Yi exactly what happened. This was Emperor Yanwen's intention. After Tang Yi listened, he stood in front of the gate of Beizhen Fusi and was silent for a long time. "Where is he buried?" After a while, Tang Yi asked. "On the highest mountain ten miles outside Beicheng, you can see further to the north." Ning Chuan raised his head and looked to the north. "Thank you." Tang Yi smiled and said, "Let's go see Uncle Xiao and Old General Di." ...less than half an hour later. In a restaurant outside Zhuangyuan Street. When Tang Yi opened the door, he saw Xiao Ce and Di Cang already inside. When the two of them saw him, their eyes were burning. After what happened to Xiao Di just now, Tang Yi felt a little hairy. He leaned back and swallowed subconsciously. "Boy, do you have a strategy to defeat the enemy?" Emperor Yanwen asked directly. He didn't have time now, so he went straight to the point. "Yes, there's enough time. It's enough." Tang Yi didn't talk nonsense. He wanted to seize power by force, and he was very humble. He said: "The strategy to retreat from the enemy is: resist Dongyu in the east and release Beidi in the north." "To put it simply, block the border immediately in the east, cut off all contact with Dongyu, mobilize heavy troops to gather at the border, and act as if they are going to attack Dongyu with all their strength." "Since they broke the contract, then adopt a fight-or-die attitude.
"As for our Yanbei border, we can tighten it internally and loosen it externally. We can directly open the border trade in advance, and even get a discount. In the past, a sheep could be exchanged for fifty kilograms of rice, but now a sheep can be exchanged for sixty kilograms of rice..." Before Tang Yi could finish his words, Emperor Yanwen slapped his palm on the table, his eyes bright: "Wonderful, wonderful." "He already understood what Tang Yi meant. Fight against Dongyu in the east and liberate Beidi in the north. To put it bluntly, it means creating tension in the east and pretending to relax the alert level against Beidi in the north. The tense situation makes Dongyu think that Dayan is going to attack Dongyu, and then let Dongyu know that Dayan and Beidi are still trading with each other, so Dongyu What would Yu think? Dong Yu would definitely think that Beidi and Dayan had colluded and were waiting for their troops to die. After all, Beidi had been relying on Dayan for most of his life. As a result, Beidi had no choice but to withdraw his troops. It's winter supplies. Okay, don't you want winter supplies? Just give them to you. And when you exchange supplies, you can spread some rumors to tell the Beidi people that their khan wants to take their lives in exchange for their prosperity and wealth. There is no need for them to survive the winter. Risking your life to make wedding clothes for others... Those censors are playing dirty tricks on this, just send a censor over. Even if Beidi Khan forces a war and the morale of the army is unstable, he can still fight. "Haha... Even if Dongyu doesn't join in the fun, border trade is the best strategy to punish the Beidi royal court. "Emperor Yanwen was very excited.
Tang Yi nodded and said: "This move will not only win over the border residents of Beidi, but even the dignitaries of Beidi will not be able to sit still when they see such an exchange of benefits and will get involved... Once they get used to it, the Beidi Royal Court will not be able to make trouble again if they want to. It's easy now, then... we will take the initiative in the subsequent game. ""You can attack if you advance, and you can defend if you retreat." "Okay, okay." Emperor Yan Wen stood up excitedly, bah, the civil and military officials in this dynasty are all dog-slaughters, they are not as good as a young man. He put his hands on his hips and said to Tang Yi in a good mood, "Boy, you have done a great job this time. We will report the reward to your satisfaction." "Boy, it's really your fault. You can solve the problem in just a few words that the civil and military officials in the dynasty couldn't handle." Di Cang slapped Tang Yi on the shoulder, and he was quite satisfied. I thought this guy was just good at writing poems, but I didn't expect that he also had a good vision and could see the problems very clearly. While the civil servants and generals of the DPRK and China were still fighting among themselves, he had already thought of strategies to solve the problem. This is really rare and valuable. "This old boy Tang Jing is inhumane." The old general also cursed angrily. What a great kid. Look at this IQ, look at this courage, and look at this momentum, damn, there is no way he can compare to that bastard Tang Hua. That old boy Tang Jing is really blind.
